name: Navbar
description: A native navigation bar that floats over the dashboard in the Kiosk Satellite design language. It highlights the item for the page being shown, opens dashboard views, kiosk actions and menus, and needs no Home Assistant token. Inspired by lovelace-navbar-card.
author: dimatx

settings.title: Position
settings.description: Where the bar floats over the dashboard.

settings.title: Labels
settings.description: Show item labels under the icons.

settings.title: Show on
settings.description: Comma-separated dashboard paths where the bar appears, such as /wall-tablet,/bedroom-wall-tablet. Their views are included. Empty shows it everywhere.

settings.title: Size
settings.description: Scale of the bar and its menus.

settings.title: Edge distance
settings.description: Distance from the screen edge, in dp.

settings.title: Opacity
settings.description: Background opacity in percent. Lower values let the dashboard show through. Icons and labels stay solid.

settings.title: Collapsing
settings.description: Swipe the bar toward its edge to fold it into a small tab, and swipe the tab back or tap it to open the bar. Start open shows the bar until someone swipes it away. Start collapsed shows only the tab. Off turns the swipe off.

settings.title: Collapse after
settings.description: Seconds without a tap before an open bar folds back into its tab. 0 keeps it open until someone swipes it away.

settings.title: Menu layout
settings.description: How menus show their entries. Grid shows tiles with an icon over a short label, like an app drawer, and suits long menus such as cameras. Auto uses a grid for menus with more than 6 entries.

settings.title: Type
settings.description: Page opens a dashboard view and highlights while it is shown. Action runs a kiosk action. Menu opens a list of entries.

settings.title: Label
settings.description: Name shown under the icon and read by accessibility services.

settings.title: Icon
settings.description: Material Design Icon name, such as mdi:home-outline. Browse names at pictogrammers.com/library/mdi.

settings.title: Selected icon
settings.description: Optional. The icon while this item's page is shown, often the filled version, such as mdi:home. Leave empty to keep Icon.

settings.title: Target
settings.description: Page: a dashboard path such as /wall-tablet/kitchen. Action: camera:<view id>, music, nowplaying, screensaver, apps, reload, home or a URL. Menu: up to 16 entries as Label|mdi:icon|target separated by semicolons. The icon can be empty, and camera entries then get a camera icon.
